I added the HelloAgentWorld view and a test for it. All 6 tests pass with `./mvnw test`: the 5 new ones plus the existing context test. I haven't started the app to look at it in a browser.

**The view** (`src/main/java/dev/vaadin/agentdemo/hello/HelloAgentWorldView.java`)
- It's at `/hello-agent-world` and has a "Name" text field and a primary "Show" button. Pressing Enter also clicks the button.
- Clicking Show displays a green success notification in the bottom right, reading `Hello <name>!`. Spaces around the name are removed first.
- **Empty input:** if the field is empty or contains only spaces, no greeting appears. The field is marked invalid with "Please enter a name", a red error notification with the same text appears, and the cursor goes back to the field. The error clears as soon as you type.
- **Navigation:** the `@Menu` annotation adds it to the side menu automatically, so I didn't need to change `MainLayout`. It has a hand icon and is placed first in the menu.

**The tests**
- `src/test/java/dev/vaadin/agentdemo/BrowserlessContextConfiguration.java`: one-time setup that lets tests drive Vaadin views without a browser. Future view tests can reuse it.
- `src/test/java/dev/vaadin/agentdemo/hello/HelloAgentWorldViewTest.java` has 5 tests:
  - the button is primary
  - a name gives `Hello Agent!` as a success notification in the bottom right
  - an empty name marks the field invalid and shows the error notification
  - a name made only of spaces counts as empty
  - "Hello Agent World" appears in the side navigation

I named the class `HelloAgentWorldView` to follow the usual Vaadin naming; the menu title is "Hello Agent World". The new files aren't committed yet.
